name: Stensjön - Skatås
description: Stensjön to Skatås. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Official GPX/API repeats many consecutive coordinates; de-duplicate before length, simplification, or QA processing.
Public WST map API requires a page token that may rotate; treat the stable GPX URL as the primary retrievable source.
Computed length from official and OSM geometry is about 8.64 km, while the public official distance is rounded to 9 km.

facilities.name: Parkeringsplats Stensjön
facilities.description: Stage-start parking at Stensjön. Check capacity/signage before relying on it.

facilities.name: Badplats Stensjön, norra
facilities.description: Child-friendly north Stensjön bathing place by John Halls väg, with shallow sandy beach; Mölndal confirms a seasonal toilet from roughly mid-May to September and small adjacent parking. Treat toilet as seasonal. Bathing-place dog and fishing restrictions from Mölndal apply to the bathing area, not necessarily the walking tread.

facilities.name: Rastplats Norra Långevattnet, södra änden
facilities.description: Rest area on the route with shelter, grill/fireplace, and a PIFFL firewood box. WST/Västkuststiftelsen note that paid firewood supports restocking by the trail manager/municipality. Fire only where allowed and subject to live fire-ban status. Check whether shelter and separate wind-shelter record should be de-duplicated or modeled separately.

facilities.name: Vindskydd Norra Långevattnet
facilities.description: Overnight wind shelter on a headland by Norra Långevattnet/Lackarebäcks långvatten; grill/fireplace present. Confirm whether overnight use is compatible with local protected-area rules at this exact coordinate before travel. Fire only at prepared/designated places and subject to fire bans.

facilities.name: Parkeringsplats Delsjön Södra
facilities.description: Parking by the southern Delsjön access. Check parking restrictions/signage before relying on it.

facilities.name: Delsjöbadet
facilities.description: Stora Delsjön bathing area with beach, cliffs, jetties and nearby seasonal services. Naturkartan/Göteborg material corroborates cafe/kiosk, grill, beach-volleyball and toilets in the cluster. Dense cluster with Grillplats Delsjön, Toalett Delsjön and Stora Delsjöns strand; avoid duplicate marker clutter. Food/cafe and toilets may be seasonal or opening-hours dependent.

facilities.name: Grillplats Delsjön
facilities.description: Designated grill/fireplace in the Delsjöbadet cluster. Fire only at designated places and subject to live fire-ban status.

facilities.name: Toalett Delsjön
facilities.description: Toilet and drinking-water point at Delsjön. Check seasonal/opening availability before user-facing import.

facilities.name: Delsjön Kanotcentral
facilities.description: Canoe rental/service by Stora Delsjön. Model as activity/service, not a hiking necessity. Season/opening hours not verified.

facilities.name: Skatås Motionscentrum
facilities.description: Major Skatås service hub with cafe/restaurant, drinking water and toilets; Naturkartan also marks fire site, parking, rest area and information. Some services may be opening-hours dependent. Facility centroid is west of the official route endpoint.

facilities.name: Etapptavla Skatås
facilities.description: Stage board at the Skatås endpoint.

facilities.name: Parkeringsplats Skatås
facilities.description: Main Skatås parking/access area. Check fees/signage before relying on it.

facilities.name: Delsjöområdet
facilities.description: Area-level Delsjöområdet record. Useful context for protected-area rules, access and general services, but not an exact subfacility coordinate. Do not import the centroid as a precise facility point.
